typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Agency NPN} as string,
		{Agency Name} as string,
		{Agent Status} as string,
		{Agent NPN} as string,
		{Agent Last Name} as string,
		{Agent First Name} as string,
		{Agent Middle Name} as string,
		{Carrier Agent ID Number} as string,
		{NAIC Group Code} as string,
		{NAIC Group Name} as string,
		{NAIC Company Code} as string,
		{NAIC Company Name} as string,
		{Client Code} as string,
		{Client Name} as string,
		{Client Group Number} as string,
		{Client Group Description} as string,
		{Cert Entity Code} as string,
		{Cert Entity Description} as string,
		Cert as string,
		{Cert Type Code} as string,
		{Cert Type Description} as string,
		{Cert Bundle Code} as string,
		{Cert Bundle Description} as string,
		{Cert Frequency Code} as string,
		{Cert Offering Code} as string,
		{Cert Offering Description} as string,
		{Cert Data Source} as string,
		{Cert Data Source FileName} as string,
		{ALMS Client Cert Code} as string,
		{Client Cert Product Code} as string,
		{Certification Year} as string,
		{ALMS Certification Status} as string,
		{Carrier Provided Certification Status} as string,
		State as string,
		{Cert Enroll Date} as string,
		{Certification Date} as string,
		{ReCertification Date} as string,
		{Certification Term/Expiration Date} as string,
		{Certification Score} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: true,
	wildcardPaths:['ALMS/alms_agent_cert_*']) ~> source1
source1 filter((upper({Client Name}) == 'KAISER')) ~> Filter1
Filter1 select(mapColumn(
		Agency_NPN__c = {Agency NPN},
		Agency_Name__c = {Agency Name},
		Agent_Status__c = {Agent Status},
		Agent_NPN__c = {Agent NPN},
		Agent_Last_Name__c = {Agent Last Name},
		Agent_First_Name__c = {Agent First Name},
		Agent_Middle_Name__c = {Agent Middle Name},
		Carrier_Agent_ID_Number__c = {Carrier Agent ID Number},
		NAIC_Group_Code__c = {NAIC Group Code},
		NAIC_Group_Name__c = {NAIC Group Name},
		NAIC_Company_Code__c = {NAIC Company Code},
		NAIC_Company_Name__c = {NAIC Company Name},
		Client_Code__c = {Client Code},
		Client_Name__c = {Client Name},
		Client_Group_Number__c = {Client Group Number},
		Client_Group_Description__c = {Client Group Description},
		Cert_Entity_Code__c = {Cert Entity Code},
		Cert_Entity_Description__c = {Cert Entity Description},
		Cert__c = Cert,
		Cert_Type_Code__c = {Cert Type Code},
		Cert_Type_Description__c = {Cert Type Description},
		Cert_Bundle_Code__c = {Cert Bundle Code},
		Cert_Bundle_Description__c = {Cert Bundle Description},
		Cert_Frequency_Code__c = {Cert Frequency Code},
		Cert_Offering_Code__c = {Cert Offering Code},
		Cert_Offering_Description__c = {Cert Offering Description},
		Cert_Data_Source__c = {Cert Data Source},
		Cert_Data_Source_FileName__c = {Cert Data Source FileName},
		ALMS_Client_Cert_Code__c = {ALMS Client Cert Code},
		Client_Cert_Product_Code__c = {Client Cert Product Code},
		Certification_Year__c = {Certification Year},
		ALMS_Certification_Status__c = {ALMS Certification Status},
		Carrier_Provided_Certification_Status__c = {Carrier Provided Certification Status},
		State__c = State,
		Cert_Enroll_Date__c = {Cert Enroll Date},
		Certification_Date__c = {Certification Date},
		ReCertification_Date__c = {ReCertification Date},
		Certification_TermExpiration_Date__c = {Certification Term/Expiration Date},
		Certification_Score__c = {Certification Score}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('alms_agent_', toString(currentUTC(), 'yyyyMMdd'), '.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> InsertAgentCert
